players.product: Optical fiber preform (PCVD and VAD/OVD), single-mode and multimode fiber and cable for telecom and AI data centers (G.654.E, polarization-maintaining, multi-core, hollow-core fiber, high-fiber-count ribbon cable); optical interconnect components (optical modules, AOCs, MPO / MMC connectors, FAUs)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: YOFC has laid out 8 production bases in 6 countries including Indonesia, South Africa, Brazil, Poland, Germany and Mexico, and has moved from mainly overseas production to overseas customer development, R&D and production delivery run as local entities; 2025 was the tenth year of its Indonesian fiber production base.
